simple.meaning: to emaciate , i.e. make ( become ) thin (literally or figuratively)

definitions.short: to emaciate , i.e. make ( become ) thin (literally or figuratively)
definitions.full: H7329. razah רָזָה verb be or grow lean (Arabic grow thin and weak ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular רָזָה Zeph 2:11 object false gods, apparently make lean ( ᵑ9 attenuavit ; ᵐ5 is ἐξολεθρύσει ), but sense strange, < רִזָּה (see Arabic above), yet even this very doubtful. Niph`al be made lean, Imperfect 3masculine singular יֵרָזֶה בְּשָׂרוֺ מִשְׁמַן Isa 17:4 .
